//: FleetOS shell dedicated typecheck project (F311 P2-a, per F310A's lane finding §8-P2a). The shell lives inside packages/web but is NOT part of the ZCode substrate web app: it has its own standalone build (vite.fleetos.config.ts) and composes the @fleetos domain packages directly in-browser. Checking it under the substrate web project's context (DOM libs, no Node types, no allowImportingTsExtensions) produced 220 false-context errors at the root gate (TS5097 on the domain packages' .ts imports + TS2591 on their node:crypto usage — see docs/evidence/F310A/report.md §6). This project gives the shell the DOMAIN context its sources actually rely on: Node types for the crypto-shim/command-path modules, allowImportingTsExtensions for the domain packages' internal .ts import convention (safe under noEmit), the same strictness family as the substrate web project (extends the same base; no new strictness added or removed — the shell's own real errors remain errors and are being fixed at their source).
